description: A dented aerosol can in Prismatik house colours, the wraparound label worn down to the hazard diamond and the tail of the wordmark. PRISMATIK. ONE CAN. EVERY COLOUR. A mixing head under the cap draws from four pigment cells and a white, and the collar clicks through the full range as you turn it, which is where the 167 comes from; the marketing never says 167 of what. Industrial marking paint underneath all that, meant for numbering pipework in a plant nobody has run in decades and used since for absolutely everything else. It rattles when you pick it up. That is the only gauge it has.
name: Chromaflux 167 Spraycan
